```{r, load and prep data}

master_tier5 <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"), "master_tier5.csv")
)

master_tier5_clean <- master_tier5 %>%
    filter(Flux > 0, 
         Dist != 48) %>%
  mutate(
    Study.Phase = factor(Study.Phase, levels = paste0("M", 1:12)),
    Site = factor(Site, levels = c("GiantMarsh", "SanPablo", "Buck'sLanding", "CorteMadera")),
    Tran = factor(Tran),
    marsh_edge_type = as.factor(marsh_edge_type),
    marsh_orientation = as.factor(marsh_orientation), 
    Month = factor(
      Month, levels = c("Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec",
                                       "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun")), 
    Phen_Period = factor(
      Phen_Period,
      levels = c("Late_Dry\n(Months 1-3)", "Tran\n(Months 4-6)",
                 "Wet\n(Months 7-9)", "Growth\n(Months 10-12)")
  )
)



```

## Flux over calendar date

```{r, rq1 time}

summary_df <- master_tier5_clean %>%
  group_by(Site, Tran, Month) %>%
  summarise(median_flux = median(Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
            q25 = quantile(Flux, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            q75 = quantile(Flux, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

rq1_time_trend = ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Month, y = median_flux, color = Tran, fill = Tran)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Site, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = transect_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = transect_colors) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(x = "Date Removed from Field", y = expression(Median~Flux~(g/m^2/day)),
       color = "Transect", fill = "Transect") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 18))
rq1_time_trend

ggsave(file.path(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"), "rq1_time_trend.png"),
       plot = rq1_time_trend,
       width = 13.33,
       height = 7.5,
       dpi = 300,
       limitsize = FALSE)

rq1_time = ggplot(master_tier5_clean, aes(x = Month, y = Flux, color = Tran, fill = Tran)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(Month, Tran)), 
               alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, 
               position = position_dodge(width = 6)) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 1.5, dodge.width = 6),
              size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~Site, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(values = transect_colors)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(values = transect_colors)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(x = "Date Removed from Field", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day)),
       color = "Transect", fill = "Transect") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
rq1_time

ggsave(file.path(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"), "rq1_time.png"),
       plot = rq1_time,
       width = 13.33,
       height = 7.5,
       dpi = 300,
       limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r, aggregate per Study.Phase-Site}

total_summary <- master_tier5_clean %>%
  group_by(Site, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"

mean_month_site = ggplot(total_summary, aes(x = Month, y = mean_flux, group = Site, color = Site)) +
```

```{r, Study Phase by marsh group and transect}

phase_compare <- master_tier5_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Marsh_Group = case_when(
      Site %in% c("SanPablo", "GiantMarsh") ~ "San Pablo + Giant Marsh",
      Site %in% c("Buck'sLanding", "CorteMadera") ~ "Buck's Landing + Corte Madera",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Marsh_Group)) %>%
  group_by(Marsh_Group, Site, Tran, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

phase_compare_grouped <- phase_compare %>%
  group_by(Marsh_Group, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = weighted.mean(mean_flux, n, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sqrt(sum(se_flux^2 * n^2, na.rm = TRUE)) / sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(phase_compare_grouped, aes(x = Month, y = mean_flux, color = Marsh_Group, group = Marsh_Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Majority Month Deployed", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^2/day)), color = "Marsh Group")

mean_month = ggplot(phase_compare, aes(x = Month, y = mean_flux, color = Tran, group = Tran)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(transect_colors)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Month Majority Deployment", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^2/day)), color = "Transect") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r, temporal marsh models}

edge_time_model <- lmer(
  Flux ~ marsh_edge_type * Month + (1|Site),
  data = master_tier5_clean
)
summary(edge_time_model)
anova(edge_time_model)

```

```{r, edge time glmm}

edge_time_model_glmm <- glmmTMB(
  Flux ~ marsh_edge_type * Month + (1|Site),
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = master_tier5_clean
)
summary(edge_time_model_glmm)
Anova(edge_time_model_glmm, type = "II")

sim_res_edge_time <- simulateResiduals(edge_time_model_glmm)
testTemporalAutocorrelation(sim_res_edge_time, time = master_tier5_clean$Month)

# AR1 version, since this is repeated monthly sampling
master_tier5_clean_ar <- master_tier5_clean %>%
  mutate(Month_ar = factor(Month, ordered = FALSE))

edge_time_model_glmm_ar1 <- glmmTMB(
  Flux ~ marsh_edge_type * Month + ar1(Month_ar + 0 | Site),
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = master_tier5_clean_ar
)
summary(edge_time_model_glmm_ar1)

AIC(edge_time_model_glmm, edge_time_model_glmm_ar1)

```

```{r}

# Replace `Interval_Length` with whatever your actual column is called
# (Date.removed.from.field - Date.placed.in.field, in days) in the code
# that built rq_plots.

interval_summary <- master_tier5 %>%
  mutate(Interval_Length = as.numeric(Date.removed.from.field - Date.placed.in.field))

# Statistical threshold rather than an eyeballed cutoff -- flag anything
# above Q3 + 1.5*IQR (standard outlier rule), OR anything you and Matt
# agree is operationally "too long to trust" (e.g., >35 days). Pick one;
# shown here with both so you can compare.
q <- quantile(interval_summary$Interval_Length, c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
iqr_cutoff <- q[2] + 1.5 * (q[2] - q[1])

long_intervals <- interval_summary %>%
  filter(Interval_Length > iqr_cutoff | Interval_Length > 35) %>%
  select(Site, Month, Study.Phase, Date.placed.in.field, Date.removed.from.field, Interval_Length) %>%
  arrange(Date.removed.from.field)

long_intervals
```

```{r}

# directly from long_intervals. Revisit this once the broad test below
# is done and you want a more targeted version.
# exclude_site_phase <- long_intervals %>%
#   distinct(Site, Study.Phase)

# Option B (active) -- drop December everywhere, for a first-pass sensitivity check
december_phases <- master_tier5 %>%
  filter(Month == "Dec") %>%
  distinct(Study.Phase) %>%
  pull(Study.Phase)

december_phases

# ---- 3. Build the sensitivity tier ----------------------------------------
master_tier5_sensitivity <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "all", "full") %>%
  filter(!(Study.Phase %in% december_phases)) %>%
  # anti_join(exclude_site_phase, by = c("Site", "Study.Phase")) %>%   # swap in for the site-specific version later
  average_replicates() %>%
  filter(n_reps > 0)

# ---- 4. Run both scenarios -------------------------------------------------
general_with    <- make_flux_table(master_tier5,             title = "Including December")
general_without <- make_flux_table(master_tier5_sensitivity, title = "Excluding December")

phase_with    <- make_flux_table(master_tier5,             group_vars = "Study.Phase",
                                 title = "By Study Phase — including December",
                                 group_labels = list(Study.Phase = "Study Phase"))
phase_without <- make_flux_table(master_tier5_sensitivity, group_vars = "Study.Phase",
                                 title = "By Study Phase — excluding December",
                                 group_labels = list(Study.Phase = "Study Phase"))

# ---- 5. Comparison tables --------------------------------------------------
overall_comparison <- bind_rows(
  general_with$data    %>% mutate(Scenario = "Including December", .before = 1),
  general_without$data %>% mutate(Scenario = "Excluding December", .before = 1)
)

phase_comparison <- bind_rows(
  phase_with$data    %>% mutate(Scenario = "Including December", .before = 1),
  phase_without$data %>% mutate(Scenario = "Excluding December", .before = 1)
) %>%
  arrange(Study.Phase, Scenario)

overall_comparison
phase_comparison
```

```{r}

# ---- Exclusion list: every Site + Study.Phase combo flagged as a long interval
exclude_site_phase <- long_intervals %>%
  distinct(Site, Study.Phase)

exclude_site_phase   # check this before it drives anything below

# ---- Build the sensitivity tier, excluding all flagged combos -----------
master_tier5_sensitivity_all <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "all", "full") %>%
  anti_join(exclude_site_phase, by = c("Site", "Study.Phase")) %>%
  average_replicates() %>%
  filter(n_reps > 0)

nrow(master_tier5)
nrow(master_tier5_sensitivity_all)   # should be smaller than master_tier5, and smaller
# than master_tier5_sensitivity (December-only)
```

```{r}
                             group_labels = list(Study.Phase = "Study Phase"))

overall_comparison_3way <- bind_rows(
  general_with$data       %>% mutate(Scenario = "Including all",                .before = 1),
  general_without$data    %>% mutate(Scenario = "Excluding December only",      .before = 1),
  general_all$data        %>% mutate(Scenario = "Excluding all flagged intervals", .before = 1)
)

overall_comparison_3way
```
